sql_templates.description: Fetch all report runs with missing data or broken report links from the last 3 months.
sql_templates.template:
SELECT runs.run_id, runs.run_ts, stocks.symbol, stocks.recommendation
FROM report.enhanced_runs runs
JOIN report.enhanced_filtered_stocks stocks ON runs.run_id = stocks.run_id
WHERE runs.run_ts > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
AND (stocks.recommendation IS NULL OR stocks.score < 50)
ORDER BY runs.run_ts DESC;
